GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2020-07-29T20:42:08Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Upgraded from V4 to V4 - simple Find(Query.All()) stopped working
Description: Searched for this but found nothing.

Problem:

This works fine in V4, fails to produce usable results in V5. 

This pretty basic operation has been upgraded to V5. Data file has been upgraded using LiteDB Studio.

               using (var db = new LiteDatabase(@ConfigDBConnection))
                {
                    var items = db.GetCollection<Item>(collection);

                    var results = items.Find(Query.All());

                }

New LiteDatabase produces what looks like a valid LiteDB.LiteDatabase reference.

GetCollection returns a seemingly valid object reference to the right type: "LiteDB.LiteCollection<AIMFacTool.Item>"

V5 Query.All produces an unusable "System.Linq.Enumerable.WhereSelectEnumerableIterator<LiteDB.BsonDocument, AIMFacTool.Item>" and an error in the ResultsView of "Error The function evaluation requires all threads to run."

Whereas V4 produces a usable "LiteDB.LiteCollection<AIMFacTool.Item>" object.

I am hoping there is a workaround or alternative I can use, otherwise I will have to revert back to V4.

Am looking forward to using LiteDB Studio though so I am keeping my hopes up that this is an easy fix.

Thanks in advance for your help.
